# origincloud_billing_legal_document (Data Source)

A legal document: every version of one kind of document, such as the Terms of Service.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The document's resource name, `legalDocuments/{legal_document}`, where `{legal_document}` is one of `terms`, `dpa`, `sla`, `aup`, `subprocessors`, `toms`, `privacy`, `switching` and `shared-responsibility`.

### Read-Only

- `acceptance_required` (Boolean) Whether a customer accepts this document. A `MATERIAL` version of one that is accepted needs a new acceptance; the other documents are published only.
- `current_version` (String) The full name of the version in force today, `//billing.origincloudapis.eu/legalDocuments/{legal_document}/versions/{version}`. Empty while the first version has not taken effect yet.
- `display_name` (String) The document's title, as its latest version names it, such as `Terms of Service`.
- `id` (String) The legal document's full resource name, `//billing.origincloudapis.eu/legalDocuments/{legal_document}`: what an argument that refers to the legal document takes. `name` is the relative name, without the host.
- `latest_version` (String) The full name of the latest version published: `current_version`, or a version announced to take effect later.
